name: Group Interactions
description: Shared tasks and gatherings for an existing adult cast. Entries separate working areas and roles; a group means the requested participants, not additional people.
entries: A group cleaning a room, each working in a separate area with tools kept outside the others' paths.
A group gathered around a board, one person writing while the others face the board from staggered positions.
A group walking in single file along a narrow trail, leaving space between each person's steps.
A group spreading a large cloth over a table, each holding a separate section along its edge.
A group seated around a meal, passing dishes through the spaces between place settings.
A group building a model, each assembling a separate part around an uncluttered central surface.
A group stacking crates, one person aligning an empty space while the others approach from separate sides with their loads.
A group watching a demonstration, one person showing a tool while the others form a loose semicircle outside its working area.
A group seated in a circle facing inward, one person holding up an object for discussion while the others turn toward it with space between their seats.
A group standing shoulder to shoulder in a line, each facing forward on their own feet while one person at the end gestures toward a shared destination.
A group resting on a broad platform, one person seated upright at one edge, another reclining with their back supported, and the others sitting with separate space for their legs.
A group gathered around a worktable, one person steadying a workpiece, another aligning a tool and the others sorting parts along separate edges.
A group passing one supply item along a line, one person receiving it at one end, another handing it over and the others waiting within reach along the line with hands free.
A group carrying a rigid frame horizontally, one person at each end and the others spaced along its sides, each gripping a separate section and sharing the load.
A group examining a map laid flat, one person pointing from one side, another holding a corner and the others leaning in from the remaining sides without overlapping hands.
A group assembling a shelter, one person bracing an upright pole, another tensioning a line and the others securing separate supports around its perimeter.
A group sorting supplies into containers, one person checking a list, another placing an item and the others arranging separate piles around the shared surface.
A group rehearsing a performance, one person facing the others and marking the rhythm while the others stand in a shallow arc with room to move their arms.
A group planting a garden bed, one person kneeling to dig, another holding a seedling and the others spacing containers along the outside edge, keeping the bed clear of feet.
A group loading a cart, one person holding its handles steady, another placing a box in its center and the others waiting beside separate boxes outside the loading path.
